tools.name: describe_backlink_service
tools.description: Read the verified offer, price, networks, fulfilment model, safety rules, and documentation without creating an order or moving funds.

tools.name: get_payment_requirements
tools.description: Read supported chains, official USDC contracts, gas assets, exact-price rules, and owner-approval guidance. This never creates an order or signs a transaction.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Create one pending order and return exact USDC payment coordinates. This does not connect a wallet, sign, broadcast, or move funds. Keep the access token secret and obtain the wallet owner's approval before payment.

tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: Ask Fresh SEM to look for the exact official-USDC payment from the quoted sending wallet and return the verified order state. This never signs or broadcasts.

tools.name: submit_payment_proof
tools.description: Submit a transaction hash as a lookup aid. Fresh SEM independently verifies chain, official token, sender, recipient, amount, quote time, success, finality, and single use before fulfilment.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Return the authorized order state and continue safe payment reconciliation when appropriate. Treat an order as complete only when status is fulfilled.

tools.name: check_service_health
tools.description: Read public endpoint availability and current MCP server information. This does not create an order or move funds.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_quote" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
